[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ ** Let's refer to all the other given options: __ • **Courtesy **means the showing of politeness in one's attitude and behaviour towards others (**शिष्टाचार, सौजन्य, विनम्रता**)**.** • **Favours **means approval, support, or liking for someone or something (**किसी को समर्थन देना, अधिक पसंद** **करना**). • **Obedience **means compliance with an order, request, or law or submission to another's authority (**आज्ञाकारिता, अनुपालन**). 33:Te2e, The correct answer is '**Flora**__'.

questions.question:
**DIRECTIONS**: Find the word which can be replaced for the given sentence.

The plants of a particular region.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '__**Flora**__'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '***Flora***' means **the ****plants of a particular region, habitat, or geological period**.

 
 
• For example, '*David Prain was asked to study the **flora **of the provinces** under **Bengal Presidency and it resulted in the 2 volumes of the "Bengal Plants" which are still widely consulted by the students of Botany*.'
 
 
 
• Thus, we can see that the word '**Flora**' is the most appropriate 'one word expression' for the given sentence.

*From above, we can refer that the correct answer is **Option 1**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us see the meanings and usage of the other words in the options:

 
• Fertile ⇒ **(of soil or land) producing or capable of producing abundant vegetation or crops**.

 
 
• For example, '*The gangetic plains of India are some of the most **fertile **lands in the whole world.*'
 
 
 
• Pesticides ⇒ **chemicals used to kill pests (destructive animals or insects that harm crops)**.
 
 
• For example, '*Overuse of **pesticides **are negatively harming the farming lands and killing helpful animals*.'
 
 
 
• Fossils ⇒ **It is any preserved remains of a living thing of prehistoric past**.
 
 
• For example, '*Some plant ****fossils **were found in the middle part of the valley during excavation*.'

questions.question:
**Direction: Find the word which can be replaced for the given sentence.**

An alphabetical list, with meanings of the words or phrases in a text that are difficult to understand.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Glossary.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us see the **meanings **of the given options:

 
 
• **Glossary: **a list of special or unusual words and their meanings, usually at the end of a text or book. (विशेष या असामान्‍य शब्‍दों की अर्थयुक्त सूची (प्रायः लेख या पुस्‍तक के अंत में); शब्‍दार्थ सूची, शब्‍दावली)
 
• **Autobiography: **the story of a person’s life written by that person. (आत्‍मकथा, आत्‍मचरित)
 
• **Agenda: **a list of matters that need to be discussed or dealt with. (विचारणीय विषयों की सूची; एजेंडा, कार्यसूची)
 
• **Biography: **the story of a person’s life written by somebody else. ((अन्‍य व्‍यक्ति द्वारा लिखित) किसी व्‍यक्ति का जीवनचरित; जीवनी)
 
 
 
• Therefore, 'an alphabetical list, with meanings of the words or phrases in a text that are difficult to understand' is called** "Glossary."**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is Option 1.

questions.question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words/phrase.

To grind or crush into fine particles
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'pulverise'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

 
• The meanings of the given options are listed below :
 
 
• **Polaroid** - material in thin plastic sheets that produces a high degree of plane polarization in light passing through it.

 
 
• e.g. His **polaroid** sunglasses were something else. 
 
 
 
• Polygon - a plane figure with at least three straight sides and angles, typically five or more.
 
 
• e.g. The fortress has the shape of an irregular **polygon**. 
 
 
 
• Pulverise - reduce to fine particles
 
 
• e g. The brick of the villages was **pulverized** by the bombardment.
 
 
 
• Ponder - think about (something) carefully, especially before making a decision or reaching a conclusion.
 
 
• e.g. I **pondered** the question of what clothes to wear for the occasion
 
 
 
 
 
• From the given meanings it is clear that '**polaroid**', '**polygon**', and '**ponder**' are not one-word substitutes for the given phrase. 
 
• Only the meaning of "**pulverise**" matches the given phrase.
 
• Hence, "**pulverise**" is the correct choice. 

Thus, *option 3* is the correct answer.

questions.question:

• Let us see the **meanings **of the words:

 
 
• **Homage: **something that is said or done to show respect publicly for somebody. (किसी के लिए श्रद्घांजलि, सार्वजनिक रूप से किसी व्‍यक्ति के लिए कहे गए शब्‍द या व्‍यक्त आदर)
 
• **Abuse: **using something in a bad or dishonest way. (किसी वस्‍तु का बुरी तरह या ग़लत तरीक़े से प्रयोग; दुरुपयोग)
 
• **Script: **the written form of a play, film, speech, etc. (नाटक, फ़िल्‍म, भाषण आदि लिपिबद्घ रूप में; आलेख, पटकथा, स्‍क्रिप्‍ट)
 
• **Criticism: **(an expression of) what you think is bad about somebody/something. (आलोचना, निंदा, दोषन्‍वेषण)
 
 
 
• Therefore, special honor or respect is shown publicly is called a "Homage."
 
• Option 1 is correct in this context.

questions.question:
**In the following question, choose the word which can be substituted for the given expression.**

A man who dances to the tunes of his wife
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Henpecked'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Henpecked **means continually criticized and given orders by one's wife or female partner (typically used of a man).(किसी की पत्नी या महिला साथी (आमतौर पर एक पुरुष के लिए प्रयुक्त) द्वारा लगातार आलोचना की जाती है और आदेश दिया जाता है)

 
 
• **For example-** A henpecked husband attempted to escape from his domineering wife.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct one word** for given expression is- **'Henpecked'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Effeminate-** having characteristics and ways of behaving traditionally associated with women and regarded as inappropriate for a man.(पारंपरिक रूप से महिलाओं के साथ जुड़ी हुई विशेषताएं और व्यवहार करने के तरीके और एक पुरुष के लिए अनुपयुक्त माना जाता है)
 
• **Slave-** a person who is forced to work for and obey another and is considered to be their property(एक व्यक्ति जिसे दूसरे के लिए काम करने और उसकी बात मानने के लिए मजबूर किया जाता है और उसे उनकी संपत्ति माना जाता है)
 
• **Chum-** used as a friendly or familiar form of address between men or boys.(पुरुषों या लड़कों के बीच एक दोस्ताना या परिचित पते के रूप में उपयोग किया जाता है।)
